info.description: Self-hosted note-taking application API. Health probes are available at root paths `/livez` and `/readyz` (outside `/api/v1`). Every response carries an `X-Request-Id` header identifying the request in the server's logs and traces; quote it when reporting a failure. A request may send its own `X-Request-Id` (at most 64 characters of `[A-Za-z0-9._-]`) to have it used instead; any other value is replaced.

get.description:
format=jot (the default) is a Jot backup bundle: a zip file holding notes.json (the notes, format jot_export version 2) and an images/ folder with every image attached to the exported notes. Each note carries its created_at and updated_at, which import restores.
format=markdown is a plain-Markdown folder that opens as an Obsidian vault: one notes/<slug>.md per note, with labels, color, pinned, archived, note type and timestamps in YAML front-matter, list notes written as task lists, and images in a shared images/ folder linked as ../images/<sha256>.<ext>. Jot cannot import it back.
Either format covers the notes the user owns, including images collaborators added to them.
get.summary: Export notes as a zip

post.description: jot_json takes a Jot export bundle (.zip, as produced by GET /notes/export) of up to 1 GiB; a bare JSON file from an older export is rejected. Notes are imported all-or-nothing; an image that is missing or invalid is left off its note and listed in errors. google_keep takes a Takeout .zip or a single .json file of up to 32 MiB.

post.summary: Reorder a list note's items

post.description: Sets completed to the given value on each of the named items and returns the note's full item list. Each item that is checked or unchecked applies the parent/child cascade: a top-level (parent) item carries the same value to all of its children, and unchecking a child also unchecks its parent. A single tap is a one-element item_ids; bulk "uncheck all" (completed=false) and its undo (completed=true) pass the whole set. IDs that do not belong to the note are ignored, so a stale tap on a since-deleted item returns 200 with the current list.

put.description: Sets the state of the note's public read-only link. With no link, or only an expired one, a link with a new token is created (an expired link is never revived). With an active link only expires_at changes: the token, created_by and created_at stay, so the URL keeps working. Repeating the request has no further effect, so it is safe to retry. To get a new URL, DELETE the link and PUT again. Open to the owner and collaborators. Sends note_updated to everyone with access; the note's version and updated_at do not change.
put.summary: Create a note's public link, or change its expiry

400.description: bad request, or expires_at not in the future

delete.description: Deletes the note's public link, so its URL stops working for everyone who has it. Succeeds when the note has no link, and while public links are switched off, so links can still be cleaned up. Open to the owner and collaborators; the owner can also revoke the link of a trashed note. Sends note_updated to everyone with access when a link was revoked.

code.description: Code is stable and machine-readable; clients switch on it.

message.description:
Message is human-readable English, for logs and as a fallback. Masked
to "internal server error" for 5xx responses.

id.description:
ID is an optional client-supplied label ID. When provided it is used as the
label's primary key so an offline-created label can be replayed idempotently:
a replay whose original create already committed is rejected with 409
instead of inserting a duplicate. When empty the server generates one.

current_password.description:
CurrentPassword is required unless the account has no password yet
(has_password is false, e.g. an SSO-provisioned user), in which case it
is ignored and the request sets the first password.

base_version.description:
BaseVersion enables optimistic concurrency, matching UpdateNoteRequest:
when set, the conversion is rejected with 409 unless the note's current
version still matches it.

title.description:
Title is the converted list's title, which the client promotes from a
leading heading in the text content. Omitting it leaves the note
untitled — the behavior every client had before the field existed.

id.description:
ID is an optional client-supplied item ID. When provided it is honored so
the item keeps a stable identity for later per-item updates and offline
replay; when empty the server generates one.

parent_id.description:
ParentID nests the item under a top-level item in the same note. Empty or
omitted means the item is top-level. Replaces the former indent_level.

position.description:
Position is where the item goes in the note's order. The server may
store a different one: after the insert it re-sequences the note so
every child sorts directly after its parent, so read the stored value
from the response.

color.description:
Color is a hex color (#rgb or #rrggbb), stored and returned as lowercase
#rrggbb. Empty means the default (#ffffff).

id.description:
ID is an optional client-supplied note ID. When provided it is used as the
note's primary key so an offline-created note can be replayed idempotently:
a replay whose original create already committed is rejected with 409
instead of inserting a duplicate. When empty the server generates one.

pinned.description:
Pinned creates the note already pinned for the creating user, so a client
that let the user pin a note before it existed needs no follow-up PATCH.

viewed_at.description: ViewedAt is when the user opened the note. Omit it to mean now.

parent_id.description: ParentID, when present, re-parents the item ("" makes it top-level).

position.description:
Position, when present, moves the item. As with parent_id, the server
then re-sequences the note so every child sorts directly after its
parent, so the stored position (in the response) may differ.

completed.description:
Completed is a pointer so an omitted field is rejected rather than
silently decoding to false.

expires_at.description:
ExpiresAt is when the link stops working (RFC 3339, in the future), or
null for a link that never expires.

base_version.description:
BaseVersion enables optimistic concurrency for shared title/content
changes: when those fields are changed and this is set, the update is
rejected with 409 unless the note's current version still matches it.
Per-user-only fields (color, pinned, archived, checked_items_collapsed)
ignore this value. When omitted, shared-content updates behave as
last-write-wins writes.

color.description:
Color is a hex color (#rgb or #rrggbb), stored and returned as lowercase
#rrggbb. Empty resets to the default (#ffffff).

truncated.description:
Truncated is true when a search matched more than userSearchLimit users
and only the first userSearchLimit are returned. Always false without a
search term.

last_used_at.description:
LastUsedAt is null until the token's first recorded use, and is only
rewritten once the stored value is an hour old.

upload_volume.description:
UploadVolume is null when the upload volume's usage cannot be read
(unsupported platform or statfs error).

note_count.description:
NoteCount is the number of non-trashed, non-archived notes that carry the
label for the requesting user.

public_link.description:
PublicLink is the note's active public link, or null when it has none
(an expired link is null too). Owner and collaborators alike see it.

unread.description: Unread is null when there is nothing new for the requesting user.

version.description:
Version is an optimistic-concurrency counter bumped on every shared-content
(title/content) change. Clients echo the version their edit was based on as
base_version on update so a stale write can be rejected (issue #489).

parent_id.description:
ParentID is the item this one is nested under, or nil for a top-level
item. It replaces the former indent_level column: a group is a top-level
item plus the children that reference it. Nesting is capped at one level,
so a parent always has ParentID == nil.

created_by.description:
CreatedBy is the user who created the link, or null once that user has
been deleted.

expires_at.description: ExpiresAt is null for a link that never expires.

checked_items_collapsed.description:
CheckedItemsCollapsed is present for list notes only: whether the owner
keeps the completed-items section collapsed.

content.description: Content is present for text notes only.

images.description:
Images lists the note's images in upload order; fetch each through
/public/notes/{token}/images/{id} (or .../thumbnail).

items.description: Items is present for list notes only.

title.description: Title is always empty for a text note.

public_links_enabled.description:
PublicLinksEnabled is JOT_PUBLIC_LINKS_ENABLED; clients hide the public
link UI when it is false.

public_url.description:
PublicURL is JOT_PUBLIC_URL as a normalized origin
("https://jot.example.com"), or null when unset. Clients build public
links from it, falling back to their own address.

trash_retention_days.description:
TrashRetentionDays is JOT_TRASH_RETENTION_DAYS: how many days a trashed
note is kept before it is deleted for good. 0 means it is kept until
the trash is emptied.
